heading: Employment of non-citizens
lead: Laws prohibiting the employment of, or payment of pay or expenses to, a person who is not a citizen of the United States do not apply to personnel of the Department of Defense.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15845:235c.5:475h.5:628c.July 16, 1952, ch. 882, § 2, 66 Stat. 725. The words “appointment or” are omitted as surplusage.
